label: Glass background
desc: A full-section backdrop of flowing liquid light under a tinted glass panel; the pointer bends the light, a click sends a ripple, and glass placed inside it refracts it.
use: Behind a hero, feature block or sign-in panel (fills its parent; children are centred).

label: Glass button
desc: A pill button of liquid glass: the rim catches light, caustics flow through it and a click sends a ripple. Frosted CSS glass without WebGL.
use: Primary call to action on a rich or photographic background; round icon buttons.

label: Glass card
desc: A payment card in dark liquid glass that tilts toward the pointer while the glass refracts the tilted surface; accent colours come from the theme.
use: Checkout, wallet or billing screens; a showpiece for fintech landing pages.

label: Glass wrapper
desc: Wraps any element and gives it the glass finish: rim light, caustics and ripples drawn over its content, following its border-radius.
use: Put glass on your own cards, pills or panels without rebuilding them.

label: Glass word
desc: A word whose letter shapes are liquid glass, with rim light and flowing caustics that react to the pointer; click cycles through a list. Real text underneath.
use: One highlighted word in a hero headline.

label: Glass heading
desc: Display heading with one or more words in liquid glass, optional badge and subtitle, and a size that follows its container.
use: Hero and section headings on landing pages.

label: Glass prompt input
desc: An AI prompt box on a glass pane: auto-growing text area (Enter sends), add-context button, a mode pill that cycles Agent / Plan / Ask, and a send button.
use: Assistant and chat entry points, command bars.

label: Glass switch
desc: An on/off switch: a glass track with a molded glass thumb that refracts what is under it. A real button with role switch.

label: Glass tabs
desc: A segmented control: a glass capsule with a molded indicator that slides to the chosen tab; arrow keys, Home and End move between tabs.

label: Glass audio player
desc: A spatial audio deck in liquid glass with a procedural Web Audio synth (no files): play, previous / next, draggable timeline, live spectrum, repeat. Sound starts only when you press play.
use: Music or podcast teasers, ambient sound on a landing page.

label: Frosted button
desc: A pill button of thick frosted glass: heavy backdrop blur, fine grain, a lit edge and a soft sheen that follows the pointer. Pure CSS, no WebGL.
use: Primary calls to action over photos, gradients or video where an opaque button would feel heavy.

label: Frosted card
desc: A dark frosted payment card that tilts toward the pointer under a moving sheen; pure CSS, so it is light on the GPU.
use: Checkout, wallet or billing screens, and fintech landing pages.

label: Frosted prompt input
desc: An AI prompt box on frosted glass with agent and mode chips and a send button; a real labelled textarea.
use: Chat and AI products: a composer that floats over a hero image or gradient.

label: Frosted switch
desc: An on/off switch on a frosted track with a light glass thumb; a real button with role="switch".

label: Frosted tabs
desc: A pill tab bar on frosted glass with a sliding highlight; arrow keys, Home and End.

label: Frosted audio player
desc: A dark frosted music deck with a synthesised demo track: play, next, volume and a progress slider; never autoplays.

label: Frosted panel
desc: Wrap any content in a frosted glass panel: blur, grain, lit edge and a sheen that follows the pointer.
use: Overlays, hero cards, menus and popovers over busy backgrounds.

label: Frosted backdrop
desc: A soft drifting colour field under fine grain, made of the brand colours; the stage for frosted panes.
use: Behind a hero or sign-in panel; pairs with the other frosted components.
